what_it_is: Agent-operated development evidence on the same development build and the same kept home after setup: what the App shows on the next launch, signed out, read by one view, with nothing clicked or pressed. The labels are read from the App's source at the revision built (App.tsx, DailyWorkspace.tsx, DesktopSetupPanel.tsx, AccountStatus.tsx), not from a recorded view; a label that differs stops the walk there. It is not a person's observation and meets no criterion.
starting_state: The kept home after the setup walk, relaunched by the launcher with its network blocks on; no credential.
acts: one view, read and acted on nothing: the walk acts in no relaunch state (App Agent 0, 14 November 2026). Since unit 1 (App Agent 0's decision, 15 November 2026), a signed-out relaunch's first view is fixed once Codex has answered the account read: Settings & tools at the sign-in
never_clicked: any control that starts, resumes or forks a conversation
window_holds: full screen button Help: this button also has an action to zoom the window, Secondary Actions: zoom the window

steps.says: the relaunch, signed out, after Codex has answered the account read: the App has moved by itself to Settings & tools with Connection and access open at the sign-in, whose one sign-in button is available; the account status says Codex reports no account, and the workspace line says Codex is running and you're not signed in; nothing is pressed (unit 1, App Agent 0's decision). The wait is 55 s: from the App beginning Codex's start, Codex is ready within the App's own limits of 20 s for the version-label probe and 20 s for the initialize handshake (app/src-tauri/src/hosting.rs HostConfig probe_wait_limit and wait_limit), and the App moves only if the account read answers within 10 s of its window first seeing that Codex ready (FIRST_VIEW_MOVE_BOUND_MS, app/src/App.tsx, a product bound); the App states no bound from the window standing to Codex's start, so 5 s is added as a margin (in the examination's launches of 14 and 15 November the App's Codex process started within 2 s of the App's: an observation). A slower start fails for timing, not for the behaviour. A read that answers more than 10 s after Codex is seen ready leaves the App on Run a workflow with the line "Codex is running. You're not signed in.": not passed, the move's bound its cause, not another accepted view. If Codex has not answered, the line reads "Codex is running. Checking whether you're signed in. If a sign-in is kept, Codex checks it with OpenAI." or "Codex is running. It didn't say whether you're signed in.", or a start that failed a limit reads "Codex was not started", and the step is not passed, with that line as its cause: it is not another accepted view. The whole view is kept
